headline: Chip Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch

writeup.headline: Chip Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Wholesale Inflation Jumps 6.5%, Yields Push Past 5%. The big swing: chip stocks rallied early, then turned around after 9:33 AM and are now lower on the day — 24/7 Wall St. points to “AMD Tumbles 11%, Broadcom and Intel Slide 6% as Chip Rally Reverses”. The AI names are down and the average stock is down: stocks are moving together. Defensive sectors are leading cyclical ones, and the S&P has stayed under pressure.

themes.headline: Chip stocks gave back their early rally
themes.detail: Down 0.3% at 9:33 AM, now -4.6%; hardest hit since: Advanced Micro Devices, Broadcom. In the news: “AMD Tumbles 11%, Broadcom and Intel Slide 6% as Chip Rally Reverses” (24/7 Wall St.).

themes.headline: S&P has stayed under pressure
themes.detail: Low at 10:21 AM, high at 9:31 AM; -1.3% since the open.
